'''Shem-Lern's starship''', a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] vessel, was the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of gunrunner [[Shem-Lern]], who had information on the capture of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
